title: Faked Gemini spacewalk photo of Michael Collins

tellings.quote: And the Gemini 15 photo, I think, as you pointed out, is verifiably fake.

plain: A NASA photo of the astronaut Michael Collins on a spacewalk during the Gemini missions of the 1960s is, in Jesse Michels's words, "verifiably fake". Michels says this in a conversation with Joe Rogan, agreeing with a point he credits to Rogan. He offers it as a sign that NASA's official images cannot always be taken at face value.
